title: Alpaca entries that fill after the 3 s place() confirm poll keep the package signal price as entry_price, and their P&L is still labelled venue_fills_net (15 of 65 stock entries, 11-09..11-25)
note: Filed 2026-11-26 ~12:50Z by ML-PRIMARY (from ALPACA-TP-PARTIAL-CANCELS-STOP-1125 part c). MEASURED: journal trades rows (diag /api/diag/journal, newest 2,200 trades) joined to Alpaca orders by broker_order_id (/api/diag/alpaca_order_history?order_ids=..., 65 order_read, 16 not_found). Population: 65 Alpaca stock entries with a filled entry order, accounts alpaca_paper / alpaca_portfolio / alpaca_live, 2026-11-09..11-25. In 15 of 65 (23%) the journal entry_price != the venue filled_avg_price; 11 of those 15 carry pnl_basis='venue_fills_net'. All 15 filled 3.5 s or more after submission (median 6.4 s, min 3.5 s); the 50 matched entries have a median delay of 1.7 s. Net journal-minus-venue P&L +1,471.86 USD (abs 2,504.83). Largest: 8521 USO +516.89 (journal 132.715 vs fill 133.165649 x 1147), 7029 IAUM +703.13, 8031 QQQ +478.54, 7031 GDX -338.05. Mismatches by account: alpaca_paper 13, alpaca_portfolio 2 (IVW 7708, SLV 7190); none on alpaca_live (1 trade checked). ROOT CAUSE (code read): src/units/accounts/alpaca_client.py place() polls GET /v2/orders/{id} for ALPACA_PLACE_CONFIRM_S = 3.0 s and returns avgPrice only on a FULL fill inside that window. Otherwise the caller keeps the package price, and NOTHING later back-fills entry_price from the venue. venue_pnl.py then labels the row venue_fills_net (exit is a venue fill) although its ENTRY is not, and pnl_computed uses the same journal entry, so pnl_gap_usd reads 0 and hides it. IMPACT: alpaca_portfolio is the Stage-2 mirror (its net-of-cost window is the demotion signal); net_r_label.py treats venue_fills_net as net, so these rows feed ml_entry net-R labels and the live-promotion path ('venue-measured P&L where available'). PROPOSED FIX (Tier 2, order path + DB writeback; not shipped, needs the operator OK): (1) back-fill entry_price from the entry order's filled_avg_price once the order reads filled (e.g. in the open-trade monitor sweep), recording an entry_price_source; (2) venue_fills_net requires a venue-verified entry as well as exit, else basis stays NULL; (3) a one-time backfill of the 15 measured rows via a system-action data job. Re-run of this measurement: the join above (scratch script described here). 2026-11-26 12:42Z (manager 26a instruction): UNTIL FIXED, alpaca_portfolio's net-of-cost window is UNRELIABLE for the affected trades (journal entry = package signal price, labelled venue_fills_net); the measured ones are IVW 7708 and SLV 7190. ML-PRIMARY is preparing (a) the entry back-fill + (b) the venue_fills_net entry requirement as a held Tier-2 PR, with (c) the 15-row backfill as a dry-run in the same PR description for one operator OK. 2026-11-26T12:53Z ML-PRIMARY: held Tier-2 draft PR #29165 (head b6e1e3bf): (a) Alpaca entries marked fill_pending_writeback, read late by the monitor's entry sweep through alpaca_entry_order_status; (b) venue_fills_net requires a venue entry, else computed_estimate + reason; (c) backfill script + system-action backfill-alpaca-entry-fill, Tier 2. The dry-run in the PR body (the script's logic over the diag reads): 12 rows to write, net +1,636.99 USD. 3 SPY rows (7583-7585) skipped: entry orders cancelled after a partial fill. 81 rows could not be checked in the sample; the VM run reads them all. Needs the operator's Tier-2 OK (the manager is asking). Closing observation after merge+deploy: a new Alpaca entry that fills after 3 s shows entry_price_source=alpaca_order_status within one monitor tick, and the backfill action's receipt lists the corrected rows. 2026-11-26T12:54Z Related row filed: ALPACA-PARTIAL-ENTRY-CANCELLED-WRONG-SIZE. SPY 7583/7584/7585 (2026-11-16): pre-open market GTC entries partly filled (24/101, 1/12, 1/2), then cancelled together at 14:32:33Z. The journal kept the requested size and closed them with exit/pnl NULL. 2026-11-26T14:44Z Operator decision, 2026-11-26 chat, verbatim: "Ok" (relayed by Manager Session 2026-11-26a; in reply to the manager's request to approve #29165 and #29091 together). Added verbatim to both PR bodies. After merge: #29091 = observe the next Alpaca close with a working entry (cancel logged, no orphan); #29165 = VM dry-run of backfill-alpaca-entry-fill, row list to the manager, --apply only if it matches the PR table (give or take unread rows), then confirm entry_price/pnl_basis on 2 rows.
